title: Perform/Understand Bag Out End-of-Sort Clearing: Close Shoots → Bag Out Back-to-Front → Exchange/Mark Items
summary: Use the end-of-sort “bag out” procedure to empty the sorter system before the next sort configuration: close every shoot, start bag out for all locations, exchange or mark any tote that has an item for exchange, then run the bag-out order back-to-front until everything is out of the system and ready for another sort.
when_to_use: Use at the end of a sort when you are done with sorting and need to clear remaining items from the sorter system so the next sort can start with a new load plan/destination.
not_for: Do not continue to the next sort configuration if bag out does not clear all locations or items remain in the system after completion.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Execute the end-of-sort bag out sequence (close every shoot, start bag out for all locations, ensure exchange/marking for totes with items, and verify the system is emptied and ready for the next sort).
access_or_tools_needed: Operational access to the sorter end-of-sort/bag-out process (as described in the provided training video segment).

access_required: Access to perform the bag out end-of-sort clearing activity.
system_preconditions: You are at the end of a sort (you are running and you are done with the sort).
Bag out is needed because between sorts the load plan and sort destination change, so everything must come out of the system.

visual_references.description: Training video frame (segment 0019) containing the bag out end-of-sort clearing description: close every shoot, start bag out for all locations, exchange/mark totes with items, back-to-front order, AGV movement pattern (farthest area then every other), and end-of-cycle everything out of the system/ready for another sort.

steps.title: Confirm you are at the end of a sort
steps.purpose: Ensure bag out is performed only when sorting is complete and the system needs end-of-sort clearing before the next sort configuration.
steps.instruction: Confirm you are done with the current sort (the point where you would transition to end-of-sort clearing).
steps.expected_result: You have reached the end-of-sort point where bag out is required to clear remaining items before the next sort.
steps.healthy_condition: Sorting is complete and you are ready to transition to clearing remaining items from the system.
steps.failure_condition: You attempt bag out while the sort is still active (sorting not yet completed).

actions.label: Verify end-of-sort state
actions.exact_action: Confirm you are at the end of a sort (“you’re running and you’re done with the sort”).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “So the way bag out works is you're running and you're done with the sort, right? And you need to bag out all the locations…”

steps.title: Close every shoot (including shoots that may be empty)
steps.purpose: Prevent further sorting into shoots and prepare the system for bag out clearing.
steps.instruction: Close every shoot as part of the bag out preparation, including shoots that may be empty.
steps.expected_result: All shoots are closed for the bag out cycle.
steps.healthy_condition: No shoot remains open during bag out clearing.
steps.failure_condition: Any shoot remains open, allowing items to continue entering during bag out.

actions.label: Close all shoots
actions.exact_action: “We close every shoot, whether it has anything in it or not.”

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “So we close every shoot, whether it has anything in it or not. All shoots are closed and we start bag out…”

steps.title: Start bag out for all locations
steps.purpose: Initiate the end-of-sort clearing cycle across the sorter locations so remaining items are removed from the system.
steps.instruction: Start bag out for all locations (bag out all locations).
steps.expected_result: Bag out is initiated for all locations as part of the end-of-sort clearing cycle.
steps.healthy_condition: The bag out cycle is running across all locations that need clearing.
steps.failure_condition: Bag out is started for only some locations, leaving items behind.

actions.label: Start bag out (all locations)
actions.exact_action: “Start bag out for all locations (“you need to bag out all the locations”).”

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “And you need to bag out all the locations… All shoots are closed and we start bag out…”

steps.title: Exchange or mark for exchange any tote with an item (one parcel)
steps.purpose: Ensure totes containing items are handled so the system can be fully emptied by the end of bag out.
steps.instruction: During bag out, ensure any tote that has an item (one parcel) is exchanged or marked for an exchange.
steps.expected_result: Totes with items are either exchanged or explicitly marked for exchange as part of bag out.
steps.healthy_condition: No tote with an item remains unhandled (not exchanged/marked) during the bag out cycle.
steps.failure_condition: A tote with an item remains in the system without being exchanged or marked for exchange.

actions.label: Verify tote exchange/marking
actions.exact_action: “any item with an item in it gets an exchange or marked for an exchange.”

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “...any tote has an item right one parcel it is exchanged at bag out.” and “any item with an item in it gets an exchange or marked for an exchange.”

steps.title: Run bag out order back-to-front
steps.purpose: Follow the required bag out ordering so the clearing cycle proceeds as intended.
steps.instruction: Ensure the bag out sequence proceeds from back to front.
steps.expected_result: Bag out proceeds in the back-to-front order as described for the end-of-sort clearing cycle.
steps.healthy_condition: The clearing pattern matches the back-to-front order (not front-to-back).
steps.failure_condition: Bag out proceeds in the wrong order, increasing travel time and potentially leaving items behind.

actions.label: Confirm back-to-front order
actions.exact_action: “And then we go from back to front.”

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “And then we go from back to front.”

steps.title: Observe AGV movement pattern during bag out (farthest area of zone, then every other)
steps.purpose: Validate that the bag out movement pattern is behaving as expected to reduce travel time.
steps.instruction: During bag out, observe that AGVs go to the farthest area of their zone first, then it goes every other.
steps.expected_result: AGVs follow the described movement pattern: farthest area of their zone, then every other.
steps.healthy_condition: AGV motion during bag out matches the farthest-area-then-every-other pattern described for bag out (less travel time).
steps.failure_condition: AGVs do not follow the described movement pattern (e.g., not back-to-front behavior or not every-other progression).

actions.label: Watch AGV movement pattern
actions.exact_action: “All the Agvs go to the farthest area of their zone… and then it just goes every other.”

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “So all the Agvs go to the farthest area of their zone… and then it just goes every other.”

steps.title: Confirm end-of-cycle completion: everything out of the system and ready for another sort
steps.purpose: Verify bag out successfully cleared the system so the next sort can start.
steps.instruction: After bag out completes, confirm the documented result: everything is out of the system and the system is ready to start another sort.
steps.expected_result: Everything is out of the system and the system is ready to start another sort.
steps.healthy_condition: No remaining items/totes are left in the sorter system after bag out completion; the system transitions to being ready for the next sort.
steps.failure_condition: Bag out does not clear all locations or items remain in the system after completion.

actions.label: Verify system emptied and ready
actions.exact_action: “once it's completed back out, right, everything is out of the system… and they're ready to start another sort.”

stop_or_escalate_if: If bag out does not clear all locations or items remain in the system after completion, stop and escalate rather than continuing with the next sort configuration.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “So once it's completed back out, right, everything is out of the system, right. And they're ready to start another sort.”

success_criteria: All shoots are closed for the bag out cycle.
Bag out is started for all locations.
Any tote with an item is exchanged or marked for an exchange during bag out.
Bag out proceeds back-to-front with the described AGV movement pattern (farthest area of zone, then every other).
After completion, everything is out of the system and the system is ready to start another sort.
healthy_conditions: Shoots are closed (no open shoots during bag out).
Totes with items are exchanged or marked for exchange.
AGVs follow the farthest-area-then-every-other movement pattern during bag out.
System is emptied at end-of-cycle and ready for the next sort.
failure_conditions: Any shoot remains open during bag out.
A tote with an item remains unexchanged/unmarked for exchange.
Bag out does not clear all locations (items remain in the system after completion).
System is not ready for the next sort after bag out completion.
escalation_guidance: If bag out does not clear all locations or items remain in the system after completion, stop and escalate rather than continuing with the next sort configuration.
